QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Castle Reconnaissance
QuestInfo.0: You finished scouting downtown. Report the situation to #bEdea#k in the #bDowntown Black Market#k.
QuestInfo.1:
Edea asked you to scout the castle, as the city itself was meaningless to Magnus when he invaded Heliseum. He was after the #bHoly Relic Outrigger#k, left by the ancient gods of the Nova. 

Scout the #bTyrant's Throne#k in the castle, to determine if Magnus is there, then return.
QuestInfo.2: The Tyrant's Throne seems to still be sealed.

1.0: Did you check inside the castle? How was it? Was the door locked?

yes.0: I see... The door being locked means the #rguardians of the throne of Heliseum#k still remain. For now, you need to defeat them first.

default.0: Could you enter the castle and see if you can find the throne? You might not be able to enter if it has a barrier up. And even if you can enter, you shouldn't. Magnus will destroy you.
